note: BLM Rawlins Field Office campground on the North Platte River north of Sinclair, an open sagebrush loop above the river with a float take-out (a control crest below the dugway; boaters are advised to start upstream). Trout fly-fishing. No horses in the campground. --Claude
summary: BLM page: free, 5 sites (1 pull-through, 4 spurs) + group site, vault toilet; rec.gov 202231 is information-only (not reservable) -> FCFS confirmed. Riverview confirmed on imagery (spurs ~35-45 m from the river with the loop road and a riparian band between; channel ~70 m wide). Pin ~75 m from the BLM point, inside the loop - fine. Phone empty -> (307) 328-4200.
flags: WATERFRONT riverview confirmed: on Esri imagery the three occupied spurs (about 41.8607,-107.0539; 41.8604,-107.0533; 41.8599,-107.0517) sit ~35-45 m from the North Platte (channel ~70 m wide, so river not creek) over open grass/sage, but the campground's own loop road runs between every spur and the bank, and the east spur has a shrub band in front - a view value per the 2026-11-01 rulings, not riverfront.
Phone: empty -> (307) 328-4200 (BLM page Contact Us: Rawlins Field Office).

Note: dropped the site/amenity list (fields), the unsourced 'Drive-in, large rigs reported' (not on the BLM page), and 'Miracle Mile/Kortes reach' (wrong: Dugway is on the river above Seminoe Reservoir, while the Miracle Mile is below Kortes Dam). hookups (none) and potable_water false stay derived - the BLM page lists amenities without water but does not say 'no water'.
